statement: ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : WM.X n × ℝ → V) (p : WM.X n × ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f p → WM.dt f p.1 p.2 = fderiv ℝ f p (0,1) ∧ ∀ j, WM.dx f j p.1 p.2 = fderiv ℝ f p (Pi.single j 1,0)
proof:
intro V _ _ f p hf
constructor
· exact ((hf.hasFDerivAt.comp p.2 (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right p.1 p.2)).hasDerivAt).deriv
· intro j
  have H : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f (y,p.2)) ((fderiv ℝ f p).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (WM.X n) ℝ)) p.1 := hf.hasFDerivAt.comp p.1 (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left p.1 p.2)
  dsimp [WM.dx]
  rw [H.fderiv]
  simp
